# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.1.2 for Windows

- Faster stem preparation on supported NVIDIA graphics cards, with lower GPU memory use. Our RTX 3090 benchmark was about 2.3 times faster than the previous processing method; results vary by hardware.
- Automatically chooses a processing method for your hardware. AMD and Intel graphics keep using DirectML, with CPU fallback if GPU processing fails.
- Downloads NVIDIA acceleration files only when needed, keeping the standard installer smaller. Once installed, they work offline.
- Choose where to store the NVIDIA download, including another drive if C: is low on space. First-time setup explains the 6 GB free-space requirement, and your choice is remembered.
- Adds a Windows processor selector and clearer processing status in Settings.

This is a Windows-only update. Existing prepared stems and compatible OverCue firmware remain usable.
